limits.state_bytes_definition: sizeof(observer)+8192 conservative bound for mutex/pointer/cache flags/serialization stack; object includes all rings/captures/zlibarena

critical_rank.1: all ways reserved at actual NEW head

trigger.ordinary_uniqueness: within slots0..2 only; critical slot may independently recapture the same physical set
trigger.dependency: ordinary highR capture and Tag mutation rely on original LIFE plus detach diagnostic preview; absent means NOT_INSTRUMENTED; no forced enabling or added probe
trigger.missed_count_semantics: not captured at notification time; replaced rank1 snapshot losses are separately explicit
trigger.new_head_seen: all actual LIFE frontend NEW notifications including lowR; join against full LIFE NEW_HEAD population, not only selected/highR snapshots
trigger.frontend_notifications: all timed actual frontend wait/admit-decision notifications, excluding early TVD-handled/ideal/bypass branches

clocks.L2_edge: zero-based global L2 clock edge counter; UNKNOWN before first L2 edge
clocks.DRAM_edge: zero-based global DRAM edge counter; UNKNOWN before first DRAM edge
clocks.ordinal: global notification/metadata order; selected windows need not be contiguous; no same-tick sorting by guessed ancestry
clocks.outside_clock: ignored and counted; initial host-prefill is not a timed Tag-allocation event

identity.uid: full uint64 wire; original source getter width retained by widening, never narrow
identity.parent: only actual live creation/split source links; otherwise UNKNOWN
identity.generation: TAG_MUTATION uses LIFE Tag incarnation; RO state/bind/create/ready/retire/detach and packet endpoints use payload generation. RO_DETACH aux is original RO tag_binding generation, a third distinct namespace. No equality between these three namespaces may be assumed.
identity.unknown_set: no extra probe, directory lookup or CAM to reconstruct missing identity

aux.TAG_MUTATION: old reserved mask bits0..3, new valid mask bits8..11, operation bits16..31; new incarnation bit32
aux.PRESSURE_NEW: ways in high32 and reserved count in low32
aux.RO_DETACH: original RO tag_binding generation t.generation before generations[index] increment; primary generation remains payload h.generation; payload slot is UNKNOWN in this event
aux.ICNT_INJECT: packet bytes; injection function executes in CORE stage, not ICNT transfer clock
aux.FRONTEND_ADMIT_DECISION: existing diagnostic raw status at controller admit decision, before actual access
aux.FRONTEND_COMMIT: existing ft_access return status!=RESERVATION_FAIL, still-live actual requester; common FT1/FT2 access path only

wire.codec: one zlib stream per snapshot, base64 chunked
wire.raw_crc32: CRC32 of serialized uncompressed80-byte events per snapshot; SHA authority remains source/raw external
wire.terminal: END completed only at explicit full-stream final stats sentinel and source drain/cap guard
wire.scope: timed kernel/backend endpoint windows; host prefill before clock ignored; no commandlist copy-event completeness claim

science.frontend_commit_scope: common FT1/FT2 cache::access ft_access result!=RESERVATION_FAIL; not an assertion that every early TVD/ideal/bypass admission traverses this hook
